prompts.halloween: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production DragonHaven Halloween app logo, also readable as a small Android launcher icon and splash emblem. Preserve that exact recognizable central egg/wing silhouette and proportions. Reimagine the complete emblem as a beautifully crafted Witchlight Halloween insignia, with burnished pumpkin-gold edging, rich enchanted violet replacing the navy, warm amber light flowing through the wing cut-outs, and small integrated sculpted pumpkin/vine details along the base of the frame. The seasonal redesign must transform the whole emblem, not be a tiny badge pasted on the original. Square image, generous 14% transparent outer margin, all decorations fully inside, genuinely transparent background with clean alpha, no checkerboard or matte, no cast shadow outside the emblem. Final intended file: assets/images/event_logos/halloween.png.
